story_type: firefighters burn a training car and attack it with a hose
hook: Firefighters set this car on fire. On purpose.
narration: Firefighters set this car on fire. On purpose.
It was a training car at Kadena Air Base, Japan, and Engine 27 rolled in like it was a real call.
Crews hit a car fire from an angle, never head on, because hot bumper struts and tires can burst.
The job was to get the hood and doors open and knock the fire down, fast.
outcome: Then they moved on to a second car, with a trapped victim inside.
title: They set this car on fire on purpose
description:
Air Force firefighters with the 18th Civil Engineer Squadron set a fire training car ablaze and attacked it with a hose line during a live fire demonstration for Fire Prevention Week at Kadena Air Base, Okinawa, Japan, on Oct. 8, 2026.

Footage: U.S. Navy video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Tyler Jackson, AFN Okinawa, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1026873/car-fire-fire-prevention-week-kadena-2026
